usedFor: Course changes in Teachfloor, such as “Module Is Created”, create or update deals and contacts in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Updated” in Teachfloor, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A changed course updates the properties of an existing HubSpot deal, so sales sees the new course details.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs a deal ID, so a run from “Course Updated” must supply it.
